product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI provides an AI-powered revenue intelligence and execution platform for sales and go-to-market teams to forecast, guide deals, and coordinate revenue workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Aviso’s homepage describes an end-to-end AI revenue platform for modern GTM teams and identifies forecasting, agentic workflows, and AI revenue capabilities, supporting the one-sentence description.

pricing_page.notes: Aviso has a public /pricing page that describes flexible plans and invites visitors to request a tailored proposal, so a public pricing page exists even though prices are not shown.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Aviso’s case-study index names both New Relic and DataStax as customer case studies. | named_customers.0: The case-study index names New Relic as an Aviso customer. | named_customers.1: The case-study index names DataStax as an Aviso customer.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile gives a company size of 201–500 employees, which directly matches the requested band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists its headquarters as Redwood City, California, US; the city component is Redwood City. | hq_country: The company LinkedIn location identifies Redwood City, California, US, supporting the United States country value.

founded_year.notes: Aviso’s company press release states that it was founded in 2012; a LinkedIn profile lists 2014, so I rely on the direct press statement and retain medium confidence given the discrepancy.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is a general sales/marketing and product blog, and its technical harness article is by Bithika Bishesh, whose Aviso bio identifies her as Manager of Research & Content rather than an engineer. The evidence does not show the two engineer-authored build-focused posts required for a true result.

public_docs.notes: Aviso’s public help center has sections for getting started, product modules, administration, mobile app, integrations, and FAQs, with numerous linked articles, meeting the requirement for public documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers index lists open roles, including account executive, customer success, demand generation, software engineer, and server-side developer; none has one of the specified AI/ML/data-science titles.

model_provider.value: GPT/ChatGPT; Aviso describes its Chief of Staff Assistant as ChatGPT-powered.
model_provider.notes: Aviso’s blog says its Chief of Staff Assistant is a ChatGPT-powered model and describes integrating GPT generative-AI capabilities, which supports GPT/ChatGPT as a publicly named model.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Aviso’s compliance page explicitly names ISO 27001, PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1, and SOC 2 Type II, and separately says it completed an internal assessment and compliance review under GDPR regulations. The listed answer reflects those named claims. | compliance_certs.0: The compliance page names ISO 27001 and says Aviso is certified to it. | compliance_certs.1: The compliance page names PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1. | compliance_certs.2: The compliance page names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.3: The compliance page says Aviso completed an internal assessment and compliance review under GDPR regulations.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding history identifies the January 2022 round as Series B; the later PitchBook financing event is expressly a secondary transaction. | funding_date: The listed latest funding round is the January 2022 Series B; the later 2025 PitchBook entry is categorized as a secondary transaction. | funding_amount_usd: The funding history lists a January 2022 Series B of $14 million. PitchBook lists a later June 2025 event as a private secondary transaction, not a later funding round; the amount is therefore the latest reported round amount. Confidence is medium because funding aggregators differ in how they label financing events.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported funding round is January 2022, before the 18-month window. PitchBook’s June 2025 entry is explicitly a secondary transaction rather than a new funding round, so the evidence does not show Aviso raising a round within the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Aviso’s careers page describes an open Account Executive position, published November 2, 2026, satisfying the specified sales-role category at the cutoff date.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviso published an announcement titled “Introducing Aviso Agentic AI” on November 6, 2026, within the six months before the November 9, 2026 cutoff, and described the new agentic system.
